name: Oren Farhi
title: Principal Frontend Engineer
subtitle: AI Product Engineer & UI Architect
summary:
Principal-level frontend engineer and UI architect with 20+ years of experience turning complex product requirements into scalable, maintainable software. Expert in TypeScript, React and end-to-end quality, with hands-on implementation, testing infrastructure and technical leadership.
Most effective in ambiguous environments: I make pragmatic architectural decisions, write the hard parts, raise engineering standards and mentor engineers. I use AI-assisted development as a force multiplier while keeping architecture, correctness and security human-led. I lead TDD and BDD strategy, own system design and technical roadmaps, and work across product, design and backend teams to improve quality and performance.
Author of Reactive Programming with Angular and NGRX (Springer) and creator of ngx-infinite-scroll (1.3M+ monthly npm downloads).
